notes: DOC 2018 marked as discontinued. Frontier-Barclays partnership extended to 2037 per SEC filings but business card availability unclear. The Frontier Airlines MasterCard BusinessCard carried a $49 annual fee, earned 2x miles on Frontier ticket purchases and 1x on other purchases, with 12,500 bonus miles on activation. Cardholders spending more than $60,000 per calendar year were upgraded to elite status. The official product page is no longer available; barclaycardus.com is cited as the issuer's homepage.
